description: bead-groups data for finding-fix: the attach ref and the relations `sc-compose bead attach` adds with the group of one important or minor finding (fix <- qa, no sanity step). The group attaches under the sprint container. Endpoints are `step:<step>` or `bead:<id>`, format strings over {vars[<name>]}.

A.description: E1 option A: the same shape under every option, since there is no sanity step. QA `blocks` on the fix (poured from `needs`); no `validates` edge, because bd keeps one edge type per bead pair.

B.description: E1 option B: the same shape under every option, since there is no sanity step. QA `blocks` on the fix (poured from `needs`); no `validates` edge, because bd keeps one edge type per bead pair.
